records.part: Truck Assemblies, Propulsion System, HVAC Parts and services for Streetcar
records.reason: Brookville Equipment Corporation is the original manufacturer of the City's streetcars and the sole source for these captive replacement parts and services.

Brookville is the OEM remanufacturer of these heritage streetcars and many or most of the parts therein, including truck assemblies, propulsion systems, HVAC, electrical and carbody are either manufactured at Brookville or are purchased and modified here at Brookville
